Category totals may not add to 100% because of missing responses ipants. The tasks that benefited most from an intervention - Changing a pie chart to a bar graph and point reading the magnitude of a single category (prevalence ratio 3.6; 95% C1 2.8-4.6) (Figure 12). This changed the comprehension rate from low to very high. - Changing the y axis of a graph so that the upward direction represented an increase rather than a decrease in the plotted quantity when judging the direction of a trend (2.9; 95% CT 2.1-9.9) (Figure 8). This changed the comprehension rate from low to high. • Including a footnote to explain an acronym and perform a task that requires knowledge of the meaning of the acronym (2.5, 95% CI 1.6-3.8) (Figure 3). This changed the comprehension rate from very low to low. • Making they axis range of two adjacent graphs match and comparing the size of a difference between the two series shown on each graph (2.0; 95% C1 1.7-2.4) (Figure 9). This changed the comprehension rate from moderate to very high. Only one intervention resulted in a reduction in comprehension; describing the pattern of trend in one layer of a stacked-layer graph after removing one layer and adding a footnote for how to interpret a layer (0.8; 95% CI 0.7-0.9) (Figure 2).
